Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing shall be held by the Board of Supervisors of Chenango County, New York on the 9th day of April 1984 at 11:00 a.m. in the Supervisors' Chambers, Third Floor, County Office Building, Norwich, New York upon a proposed Local Law by which the County of Chenango would opt to enforce the Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code.
Copies of the proposed Local Law may be obtained from the undersigned Clerk.
At the time and place of such public hearing, all interested persons will be heard for or against such proposed Law or any provision thereof.

Section 1 Legal Enactment 1.1. The Board of Supervisors of the County of Chenango, pursuant to Section 1 of Chapter 707 of the Laws of 1981 (Executive Law, Section 381 (2)), hereby elects to rescind Local Law No. 3 of 1983 which transferred the administration and enforcement of the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Codu to the Stale government. 1.2 In its stead the Board of Supervisors of the County of Chenan6o, pursuant to the above mentioned State Law, now formally adopts this County Law to be known as "A County Law Authorizing County Administration and Enforcement of the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code".

1.2 In its stead the Board of Supervisors of the County of Chenan6o, pursuant to the above mentioned State Law, now formally adopts this County Law to be known as "A County Law Authorizing County Administration and Enforcement of the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code".

Section 2. Authority 2.1 This Local Law is hereby enacted pursuant to the authority granted by Section 10 of the New York State Municipal Home Rule Law. Section 3 Purpose 3.1 This County Law shall provide the method for administration and enforcement of the New York State Uniform Fire Prevention and Building Code in the County of Chenango and shall establish powers, duties, and responsibilities in connection therewith.
